literature.headline_zh: 季节性流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: NP的泛素化增强了其与选择性自噬受体NBR1(NBR1自噬货物受体)的相互作用,从而通过宏自噬/自噬途径降解NP。 [10.1080/15548627.2026.2764577]
在所有季节中均检测到针对这三种基因型的神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体,且在接种疫苗接种前,相当比例的个体已表现出可测量的交叉反应活性。疫苗接种适度提高了神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体滴度,特别是在2009年大流行之后。 [10.1128/jvi.00929-26]
在180天DPV期间,女性对A/H3N2的中和抗体(nAb)反应比男性更强,但对A/H1N1或B/Victoria的中和抗体反应没有显著差异,其中A/H3N2反应者之间的差异最为显著(nAb滴度≥4倍变化)。在反应者中,女性与男性相比在ADMP、ADNK和nAb方面的持续性定义了流感疫苗诱导免疫中的性别差异。 [10.64898/2026.11.17.26368332]
总计39,146例住院病例中,有356例(0.9%)检测出流感C病毒,流感A病毒和流感B病毒分别为4,554例(11.6%)和1,600例(4.1%)。与流感A病毒(18.4%)和流感B病毒(15.3%)相比,流感C病毒病例中(64.3%)至少检测出一种共存的呼吸道病原体。 [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129278]
Dig通过提高存活率和降低病毒载量,保护小鼠免受H1N1和H3N8的致死性挑战。 [10.1016/j.virs.2026.11.019]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The ubiquitination of NP enhanced its interaction with selective autophagy receptor NBR1, leading to NP degradation via the macroautophagy/autophagy pathway. [10.1080/15548627.2026.2764577]

NA-inhibiting antibodies were detectable against all three genotypes across seasons, with cross-reactive activity present in a substantial proportion of individuals before vaccination. Vaccination modestly increased NA-inhibiting titers, especially after the 2009 pandemic. [10.1128/jvi.00929-26]

Females had greater A/H3N2, but not A/H1N1 or B/Victoria, neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses compared to males through 180 DPV, with differences being most pronounced among A/H3N2 responders ([≥]4 fold-change in nAb titers). [10.64898/2026.11.17.26368332]

Of a total of 39,146 admissions, 356 (0.9%) tested positive for influenza C, and 4554 (11.6%) and 1600 (4.1%) for influenza A and B, respectively. A high proportion of ICV cases (64.3%) had at least one co-detected respiratory pathogen, compared with influenza A (18.4%) and influenza B (15.3%). [10.1016/j.vaccine.2026.129278]
Dig treatment protected mice from lethal challenge with H1N1 and H3N8 by increasing survival rates and reducing viral loads. [10.1016/j.virs.2026.11.019]

papers.title: Cross-Protection against Influenza A(H5) Clade 2.3.4.4b Viruses after A(H1N1)pdm09 Infection.
papers.abstract: We challenged ferrets previously infected with influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 virus with H5N1 or H5N5 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses to assess cross-protection. Results show that previous A(H1N1)pdm09 virus immunity conferred partial protection against both viruses, with slightly reduced protection against H5N5 compared with H5N1, potentially reflecting the absence of cross-reactive N5 neuraminidase antibodies.

elements_zh.methods: 雪貂被感染了甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒,随后被挑战感染H5N1或H5N5亚型2.3.4.4b病毒,以评估免疫应答和保护效果。

papers.title: Digoxigenin is a Broad-Spectrum Antiviral Agent against Influenza A Virus via Degradation of Nucleoprotein.
papers.abstract: Seasonal influenza A viruses (IAVs; H1N1 and H3N2) and their zoonotic variants (e.g. H5N1 and H3N8) pose persistent threats to public health, highlighting an urgent need for innovative therapeutic strategies. Through high-throughput screening with the constructed reporter virus H3N8-GFP, we initially identified a panel of potential antiviral agents from FDA-approved compounds. Further validation revealed that digoxigenin (Dig), the aglycone of digoxin, significantly inhibited the proliferation of H3N8, H1N1, H3N2, and H5N1 in infected primary murine alveolar epithelial cells and ESC-derived human alveolar organoids. Dig treatment protected mice from lethal challenge with H1N1 and H3N8 by increasing survival rates and reducing viral loads.Mechanistically, Dig exerts its antiviral activity by directly binding to the host Na + /K + -ATPase α1 subunit (ATP1A1), which triggers the degradation of viral nucleoprotein via both the ubiquitin-proteasome and autophagy pathways, without affecting other components of the viral ribonucleoprotein (vRNP). Our study reveals the Dig-mediated antiviral mechanism that targets the host cell degradation machinery, and identifies Dig as a promising broad-spectrum antiviral agent against IAVs.

The research was motivated by the persistent public health threats posed by these viruses and the need for innovative therapeutic strategies. The evidence strength is high, as the findings are based on direct experimental validation in relevant cell models and animal studies.

papers.title: ZFYVE21 is an essential host factor for influenza A virus by regulating endosomal acidification
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) remains a major global health threat, causing recurrent seasonal epidemics and sporadic pandemics. Despite extensive studies on IAV-host interactions, cellular regulation of the viral life cycle is not fully understood. Here, using genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screens, we identified zinc finger FYVE domain-containing protein 21 (ZFYVE21) as a cellular factor required for completion of the IAV life cycle. We show that ZFYVE21 acts upstream of PTEN to maintain endosomal acidification, which triggers the conformational change of viral hemagglutinin (HA) required for membrane fusion and viral uncoating. Deficiency of ZFYVE21 abrogates this acidification step, thereby blocking viral genome release into the cytosol and subsequent replication across multiple IAV strains. Importantly, ZFYVE21-deficient mice exhibit significantly lower lung viral loads, diminished histopathological damage, and markedly improved survival upon lethal IAV H3N2 challenge. Collectively, our findings uncover a critical role of ZFYVE21 in endosomal acidification-dependent IAV genome release into the cytosol and establish ZFYVE21 as a promising target for the development of broad-spectrum anti-influenza therapeutics.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to identify cellular factors essential for the influenza A virus (IAV) life cycle, addressing the gap in understanding cellular regulation of viral processes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screens in human cells to identify host factors required for IAV completion of its life cycle, focusing on IAV strains H3N2 and H1N1pdm09.
analysis.methods: Genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screens were employed to knock out genes and assess their impact on IAV replication. Assays included viral titers, endosomal acidification, and viral uncoating.
analysis.main_results: ZFYVE21 was identified as a critical host factor for IAV by regulating endosomal acidification, which is essential for viral genome release into the cytosol.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that ZFYVE21 acts upstream of PTEN to maintain endosomal acidification, a novel finding that establishes ZFYVE21 as a promising target for broad-spectrum anti-influenza therapeutics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings could inform the development of new antiviral strategies and improve understanding of IAV pathogenesis, potentially leading to better treatments and prevention measures.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of genome-wide CRISPR screens, which may miss specific interactions, and the need for further validation in animal models and clinical settings.

analysis.summary_en: This study identified ZFYVE21 as a critical host factor for influenza A virus by regulating endosomal acidification, which is essential for viral genome release into the cytosol. This novel finding could inform the development of broad-spectrum antiviral strategies.

papers.title_zh: ZFYVE21是流感A病毒依赖溶酶体酸化释放病毒因子的关键细胞因子
papers.source_body_en: Influenza A virus (IAV) remains a major global health threat, causing recurrent seasonal epidemics and sporadic pandemics. Despite extensive studies on IAV-host interactions, cellular regulation of the viral life cycle is not fully understood. Here, using genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 screens, we identified zinc finger FYVE domain-containing protein 21 (ZFYVE21) as a cellular factor required for completion of the IAV life cycle. We show that ZFYVE21 acts upstream of PTEN to maintain endosomal acidification, which triggers the conformational change of viral hemagglutinin (HA) required for membrane fusion and viral uncoating. Deficiency of ZFYVE21 abrogates this acidification step, thereby blocking viral genome release into the cytosol and subsequent replication across multiple IAV strains. Importantly, ZFYVE21-deficient mice exhibit significantly lower lung viral loads, diminished histopathological damage, and markedly improved survival upon lethal IAV H3N2 challenge. Collectively, our findings uncover a critical role of ZFYVE21 in endosomal acidification-dependent IAV genome release into the cytosol and establish ZFYVE21 as a promising target for the development of broad-spectrum anti-influenza therapeutics.
papers.abstract_zh: 流感A病毒(IAV)仍然是全球主要的健康威胁,导致反复的季节性流行和偶发的大流行。尽管对IAV与宿主相互作用已有大量研究,但病毒生命周期的细胞调控机制尚未完全阐明。在此研究中,我们利用基因组全基因组CRISPR/Cas9筛选技术,鉴定了锌指FYVE结构域包含蛋白21(ZFYVE21)作为IAV生命周期完成所必需的细胞因子。我们发现ZFYVE21在PTEN上游发挥作用,维持溶酶体酸化,从而触发病毒血凝素(HA)的构象变化,这是膜融合和病毒脱壳所必需的。ZFYVE21的缺乏会阻断这一酸化步骤,从而阻止病毒基因组释放到细胞质中,并抑制多种IAV毒株的后续复制。重要的是,ZFYVE21缺失的小鼠在致命的IAV H3N2感染后表现出显著降低的肺部病毒载量、减轻的组织病理学损伤以及明显改善的存活率。综上所述,我们的研究揭示了ZFYVE21在依赖溶酶体酸化的IAV 基因组释放到细胞质中的关键作用,并确立了ZFYVE21作为开发广谱抗流感治疗药物的有前景靶点。

papers.title: Broader functional and memory antibody responses in adult females than males in response to seasonal H3N2 vaccine virus
papers.abstract: Females of reproductive ages often mount greater antibody responses than males following influenza vaccination, but the breadth and depth of these differences, including antibody-dependent Fc receptor (FcR)-mediated functions have not been explored. Plasma samples were collected from male and female healthcare workers (range of 21-48y; mean of 31y) at 0, 28, and 180 days post-vaccination (DPV) during the 2022-2023 influenza vaccine season to assess antibody responses to A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria vaccine viruses. Females had greater A/H3N2, but not A/H1N1 or B/Victoria, neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses compared to males through 180 DPV, with differences being most pronounced among A/H3N2 responders ([≥]4 fold-change in nAb titers). Memory B cells isolated from female responders secreted more IgG in response to ex vivo H3 stimulation than those from male responders at 28 and 180 DPV. Before vaccination, female responders had greater anti-H3 IgG responses and Fc{gamma}RIIB (CD32b) antibody binding than males, with females maintaining greater responses through 180 DPV. Female responders had greater H3-specific antibody-dependent monocyte phagocytosis (ADMP) and natural killer cell (ADNK) secretion of IFN{gamma} and CCL4 prior to and after vaccination, with ADMP positively correlating with greater H3N2 neutralization through 180 DPV in females only. Among responders, the durability of ADMP, ADNK, and nAb in females as compared to males defined the sex differences in influenza-vaccine induced immunity. The greater Fc{gamma}R-binding antibodies prior to vaccination in females might improve the durability of both neutralizing and non-neutralizing antibody responses to diverse vaccines, including next generation influenza vaccines.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 生育年龄的女性在感染流感疫苗接种后通常会产生比男性更强的抗体反应,但这些差异的广度和深度,包括抗体依赖性Fc受体(FcR)介导的功能,尚未被探索。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在2022-2023流感疫苗季节期间,从21-48岁(平均31岁)的男性和女性医疗工作者中收集了血浆样本,分别在感染疫苗接种后0天、28天和180天(DPV)评估其对A/H1N1、A/H3N2和B/Victoria 疫苗病毒的抗体反应。
elements_zh.methods: 在28天和180天DPV时,从女性反应者中分离的记忆B细胞对体外H3刺激的IgG分泌量高于男性反应者。
elements_zh.main_results: 在180天DPV期间,女性对A/H3N2的中和抗体(nAb)反应比男性更强,但对A/H1N1或B/Victoria的中和抗体反应没有显著差异,其中A/H3N2反应者之间的差异最为显著(nAb滴度≥4倍变化)。在反应者中,女性与男性相比在ADMP、ADNK和nAb方面的持续性定义了流感疫苗诱导免疫中的性别差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在感染疫苗接种之前,女性反应者对H3的抗-H3 IgG反应和Fc{gamma}RIIB(CD32b)抗体结合能力均高于男性,且在180天DPV期间,女性仍保持更高的反应水平。在感染疫苗接种前后,女性反应者对H3特异性抗体依赖性单核细胞吞噬(ADMP)和自然杀伤细胞(ADNK)分泌IFN{gamma}和CCL4的能力均高于男性,且仅在女性中,ADMP与H3N2中和能力呈正相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在感染疫苗接种之前,女性更高的Fc{gamma}R结合抗体可能有助于增强对多种疫苗病毒,包括下一代流感疫苗的中和和非中和抗体反应的持续性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量较小和仅在特定人群(医疗工作者)中进行的限制,因此其结果可能无法推广到更广泛的人群。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Females of reproductive ages often mount greater antibody responses than males following influenza vaccination, but the breadth and depth of these differences, including antibody-dependent Fc receptor (FcR)-mediated functions have not been explored.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: Plasma samples were collected from male and female healthcare workers (range of 21-48y; mean of 31y) at 0, 28, and 180 days post-vaccination (DPV) during the 2022-2023 influenza vaccine season to assess antibody responses to A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria vaccine viruses.
analysis_en.methods: Memory B cells isolated from female responders secreted more IgG in response to ex vivo H3 stimulation than those from male responders at 28 and 180 DPV.
analysis_en.main_results: Females had greater A/H3N2, but not A/H1N1 or B/Victoria, neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses compared to males through 180 DPV, with differences being most pronounced among A/H3N2 responders ([≥]4 fold-change in nAb titers). Among responders, the durability of ADMP, ADNK, and nAb in females as compared to males defined the sex differences in influenza-vaccine induced immunity.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Before vaccination, female responders had greater anti-H3 IgG responses and Fc{gamma}RIIB (CD32b) antibody binding than males, with females maintaining greater responses through 180 DPV. Female responders had greater H3-specific antibody-dependent monocyte phagocytosis (ADMP) and natural killer cell (ADNK) secretion of IFN{gamma} and CCL4 prior to and after vaccination, with ADMP positively correlating with greater H3N2 neutralization through 180 DPV in females only.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The greater Fc{gamma}R-binding antibodies prior to vaccination in females might improve the durability of both neutralizing and non-neutralizing antibody responses to diverse vaccines, including next generation influenza vaccines.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited by the small sample size and the fact that it was conducted in a specific population of healthcare workers. The findings may not be generalizable to the broader population.

papers.title_zh: 成年女性比男性对季节性H3N2 疫苗病毒产生更广泛的免疫功能和记忆抗体反应
papers.source_body_en: Females of reproductive ages often mount greater antibody responses than males following influenza vaccination, but the breadth and depth of these differences, including antibody-dependent Fc receptor (FcR)-mediated functions have not been explored. Plasma samples were collected from male and female healthcare workers (range of 21-48y; mean of 31y) at 0, 28, and 180 days post-vaccination (DPV) during the 2022-2023 influenza vaccine season to assess antibody responses to A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria vaccine viruses. Females had greater A/H3N2, but not A/H1N1 or B/Victoria, neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses compared to males through 180 DPV, with differences being most pronounced among A/H3N2 responders ([≥]4 fold-change in nAb titers). Memory B cells isolated from female responders secreted more IgG in response to ex vivo H3 stimulation than those from male responders at 28 and 180 DPV. Before vaccination, female responders had greater anti-H3 IgG responses and Fc{gamma}RIIB (CD32b) antibody binding than males, with females maintaining greater responses through 180 DPV. Female responders had greater H3-specific antibody-dependent monocyte phagocytosis (ADMP) and natural killer cell (ADNK) secretion of IFN{gamma} and CCL4 prior to and after vaccination, with ADMP positively correlating with greater H3N2 neutralization through 180 DPV in females only. Among responders, the durability of ADMP, ADNK, and nAb in females as compared to males defined the sex differences in influenza-vaccine induced immunity. The greater Fc{gamma}R-binding antibodies prior to vaccination in females might improve the durability of both neutralizing and non-neutralizing antibody responses to diverse vaccines, including next generation influenza vaccines.
papers.abstract_zh: 生育年龄的女性在感染流感疫苗接种后通常会产生比男性更强的抗体反应,但这些差异的广度和深度,包括抗体依赖性Fc受体(FcR)介导的功能,尚未被探索。在2022-2023流感疫苗季节期间,从21-48岁(平均31岁)的男性和女性医疗工作者中收集了血浆样本,分别在感染疫苗接种后0天、28天和180天(DPV)评估其对A/H1N1、A/H3N2和B/Victoria 疫苗病毒的抗体反应。在180天DPV期间,女性对A/H3N2的中和抗体(nAb)反应比男性更强,但对A/H1N1或B/Victoria的中和抗体反应没有显著差异,其中A/H3N2反应者之间的差异最为显著(nAb滴度≥4倍变化)。在28天和180天DPV时,从女性反应者中分离的记忆B细胞对体外H3刺激的IgG分泌量高于男性反应者。在感染疫苗接种之前,女性反应者对H3的抗-H3 IgG反应和Fc{gamma}RIIB(CD32b)抗体结合能力均高于男性,且在180天DPV期间,女性仍保持更高的反应水平。在感染疫苗接种前后,女性反应者对H3特异性抗体依赖性单核细胞吞噬(ADMP)和自然杀伤细胞(ADNK)分泌IFN{gamma}和CCL4的能力均高于男性,且仅在女性中,ADMP与H3N2中和能力呈正相关。在反应者中,女性与男性相比在ADMP、ADNK和nAb方面的持续性定义了流感疫苗诱导免疫中的性别差异。在感染疫苗接种之前,女性更高的Fc{gamma}R结合抗体可能有助于增强对多种疫苗病毒,包括下一代流感疫苗的中和和非中和抗体反应的持续性。

papers.title: Epidemiology of influenza C in Hong Kong inferred from pediatric hospitalization data
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza C virus (ICV) circulates globally causing generally mild respiratory infections. Limited data have been reported, including epidemiologic features and its potential interactions with other influenza viruses and respiratory pathogens. METHODS: We analyzed laboratory-confirmed pediatric influenza hospitalizations in Hong Kong from October 2015 to March 2025. Respiratory specimens were tested by multiplex RT-PCR for influenza A, B, and C viruses and other respiratory pathogens. We described the seasonality, age distribution, co-detections, hospitalization burden, and explored effectiveness of seasonal influenza vaccines against ICV-associated hospital admissions in comparison with seasonal influenza A and B viruses using the test-negative analysis. RESULTS: Of a total of 39,146 admissions, 356 (0.9%) tested positive for influenza C, and 4554 (11.6%) and 1600 (4.1%) for influenza A and B, respectively. A high proportion of ICV cases (64.3%) had at least one co-detected respiratory pathogen, compared with influenza A (18.4%) and influenza B (15.3%). Seasonal influenza vaccination was not effective against ICV-associated hospitalization (vaccine effectiveness: -6.2%, 95% confidence interval: -44.6% to 22.0%) but effective for influenza A (58.2%, 54.3% to 61.8%) and influenza B (68.7%, 63.0% to 73.5%). CONCLUSIONS: Our study provided important epidemiologic information on ICV infections in pediatric patients. The estimated null protection against influenza C from seasonal influenza vaccination implied the potential immunological relationship between seasonal influenza viruses and underscored the importance of continuous surveillance on influenza viruses.

It found that ICV accounted for 0.9% of all admissions, with a high rate of co-detections with other respiratory pathogens. However, the findings are based on observational data and may not fully capture the true burden of ICV infections. The results suggest that vaccine effectiveness against ICV is not established, emphasizing the importance of continued research into this area.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:流感C病毒(ICV)在全球范围内流行,通常引起较轻的呼吸道感染。关于其流行病学特征及其与其他流感病毒和呼吸道病原体潜在相互作用的数据有限。方法:我们分析了2015年10月至2025年3月期间香港的实验室确认的儿童流感住院病例。通过多重RT-PCR检测呼吸道样本中的流感A、B、C病毒及其他呼吸道病原体。我们描述了其季节性、年龄分布、共检出情况、住院负担,并利用测试阴性分析探讨了季节性流感 疫苗对与ICV相关的住院病例的预防效果,与季节性流感 A和B病毒进行比较。结果:总计39,146例住院病例中,有356例(0.9%)检测出流感C病毒,流感A病毒和流感B病毒分别为4,554例(11.6%)和1,600例(4.1%)。与流感A病毒(18.4%)和流感B病毒(15.3%)相比,流感C病毒病例中(64.3%)至少检测出一种共存的呼吸道病原体。季节性流感 疫苗接种对流感C病毒相关住院无明显保护作用(疫苗有效性:-6.2%,95%置信区间:-44.6%至22.0%),但对流感A病毒(58.2%,54.3%至61.8%)和流感B病毒(68.7%,63.0%至73.5%)有效。结论:本研究为儿童患者流感C病毒感染提供了重要的流行病学信息。从季节性流感 疫苗接种对流感C病毒无保护作用的估计结果,暗示了季节性流感病毒之间可能存在免疫学关系,并强调了对流感病毒进行持续监测的重要性。科学与公共卫生意义:这些发现提醒我们不能假设季节性流感 疫苗能提供对流感C病毒的保护,突显了需要针对监测进行专门研究以及进一步探讨疫苗对ICV有效性的重要性。局限性与证据强度:本研究依赖于住院数据,可能无法涵盖所有ICV感染病例。由于基于观察性数据和测试阴性分析,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.methods: 我们描述了其季节性、年龄分布、共检出情况、住院负担,并利用测试阴性分析探讨了季节性流感 疫苗对与ICV相关的住院病例的预防效果,与季节性流感 A和B病毒进行比较。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总计39,146例住院病例中,有356例(0.9%)检测出流感C病毒,流感A病毒和流感B病毒分别为4,554例(11.6%)和1,600例(4.1%)。与流感A病毒(18.4%)和流感B病毒(15.3%)相比,流感C病毒病例中(64.3%)至少检测出一种共存的呼吸道病原体。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究为儿童患者流感C病毒感染提供了重要的流行病学信息。从季节性流感 疫苗接种对流感C病毒无保护作用的估计结果,暗示了季节性流感病毒之间可能存在免疫学关系,并强调了对流感病毒进行持续监测的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提醒我们不能假设季节性流感 疫苗能提供对流感C病毒的保护,突显了需要针对监测进行专门研究以及进一步探讨疫苗对ICV有效性的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于住院数据,可能无法涵盖所有ICV感染病例。由于基于观察性数据和测试阴性分析,证据强度中等。

papers.title: LYN restricts the replication of influenza A virus through mediating autophagic degradation of viral nucleoprotein
papers.abstract: The continuous evolution of influenza A virus (IAV) necessitates the exploration of host-based antiviral strategies. Our previously published study demonstrated that the tyrosine kinase LYN (LYN proto-oncogene, Src family tyrosine kinase) is a novel anti-influenza factor through directly phosphorylating the IAV nucleoprotein (NP). However, more potential antiviral functions of LYN remained unclear. Here, we reveal a kinase activity-independent mechanism by which LYN restricted IAV replication. LYN functioned as a scaffold, recruiting the E3 ubiquitin ligase TRIM28 (tripartite motif containing 28) to catalyze K48-linked ubiquitination of IAV-NP at lysine 470. The ubiquitination of NP enhanced the interaction with selective autophagy receptor NBR1 (NBR1 autophagy cargo receptor), leading to NP degradation via the macroautophagy/autophagy pathway. The NPK470R mutation abrogated the LYN-mediated degradation of NP and significantly promoted IAV replication. Collectively, our findings uncovered that LYN employs a two-pronged strategy to suppress IAV infection and is a promising target for anti-influenza drug development.Abbreviation: 3-MA: 3-methyladenine; ACTB: actin beta; ANOVA: analysis of variance; ATG7: autophagy related 7; CALCOCO2/NDP52: calcium binding and coiled-coil domain 2; CHX: cycloheximide; co-IP: co-immunoprecipitation; DUb: deubiquitinase; E3: E3 ubiquitin ligase; EID50: 50% egg infective dose; GFP: green fluorescent protein; GST: glutathione S-transferase; HA: hemagglutinin; HECTD1: HECT domain E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1; HERC2: HECT and RLD domain containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 2; HIV-1: human immunodeficiency virus type 1; HRP: horseradish peroxidase; HUWE1: HECT, UBA and WWE domain containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1; IAV: influenza A virus; IgG: immunoglobulin G; LYN: LYN proto-oncogene, Src family tyrosine kinase; MOI: multiplicity of infection; NBR1: NBR1 autophagy cargo receptor; NEDD4L: NEDD4 like E3 ubiquitin protein ligase; NP: nucleoprotein; NP-40: Nonidet P-40; OPTN: optineurin; PA: polymerase acidic protein; PB1: polymerase basic 1; PB2: polymerase basic 2; PBS: phosphate-buffered saline; RIPK3: receptor interacting serine/threonine kinase 3; RNF40: ring finger protein 40; SD: standard deviation; SQSTM1/p62: sequestosome 1; STUB1: STIP1 homology and U-box containing protein 1; TNF: tumor necrosis factor; TOLLIP: toll interacting protein; TRIM27: tripartite motif containing 27; TRIM28: tripartite motif containing 28; Ub: ubiquitin; UBE3C: ubiquitin protein ligase E3C; Vec: empty vector; vRNP: viral ribonucleoprotein; XIAP: X-linked inhibitor of apoptosis; ZNF598: zinc finger protein 598.

papers.title_zh: LYN通过介导流感病毒核蛋白的自噬降解来限制流感A病毒的复制
papers.source_body_en: The continuous evolution of influenza A virus (IAV) necessitates the exploration of host-based antiviral strategies. Our previously published study demonstrated that the tyrosine kinase LYN (LYN proto-oncogene, Src family tyrosine kinase) is a novel anti-influenza factor through directly phosphorylating the IAV nucleoprotein (NP). However, more potential antiviral functions of LYN remained unclear. Here, we reveal a kinase activity-independent mechanism by which LYN restricted IAV replication. LYN functioned as a scaffold, recruiting the E3 ubiquitin ligase TRIM28 (tripartite motif containing 28) to catalyze K48-linked ubiquitination of IAV-NP at lysine 470. The ubiquitination of NP enhanced the interaction with selective autophagy receptor NBR1 (NBR1 autophagy cargo receptor), leading to NP degradation via the macroautophagy/autophagy pathway. The NPK470R mutation abrogated the LYN-mediated degradation of NP and significantly promoted IAV replication. Collectively, our findings uncovered that LYN employs a two-pronged strategy to suppress IAV infection and is a promising target for anti-influenza drug development.Abbreviation: 3-MA: 3-methyladenine; ACTB: actin beta; ANOVA: analysis of variance; ATG7: autophagy related 7; CALCOCO2/NDP52: calcium binding and coiled-coil domain 2; CHX: cycloheximide; co-IP: co-immunoprecipitation; DUb: deubiquitinase; E3: E3 ubiquitin ligase; EID50: 50% egg infective dose; GFP: green fluorescent protein; GST: glutathione S-transferase; HA: hemagglutinin; HECTD1: HECT domain E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1; HERC2: HECT and RLD domain containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 2; HIV-1: human immunodeficiency virus type 1; HRP: horseradish peroxidase; HUWE1: HECT, UBA and WWE domain containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1; IAV: influenza A virus; IgG: immunoglobulin G; LYN: LYN proto-oncogene, Src family tyrosine kinase; MOI: multiplicity of infection; NBR1: NBR1 autophagy cargo receptor; NEDD4L: NEDD4 like E3 ubiquitin protein ligase; NP: nucleoprotein; NP-40: Nonidet P-40; OPTN: optineurin; PA: polymerase acidic protein; PB1: polymerase basic 1; PB2: polymerase basic 2; PBS: phosphate-buffered saline; RIPK3: receptor interacting serine/threonine kinase 3; RNF40: ring finger protein 40; SD: standard deviation; SQSTM1/p62: sequestosome 1; STUB1: STIP1 homology and U-box containing protein 1; TNF: tumor necrosis factor; TOLLIP: toll interacting protein; TRIM27: tripartite motif containing 27; TRIM28: tripartite motif containing 28; Ub: ubiquitin; UBE3C: ubiquitin protein ligase E3C; Vec: empty vector; vRNP: viral ribonucleoprotein; XIAP: X-linked inhibitor of apoptosis; ZNF598: zinc finger protein 598.
papers.abstract_zh: 流感A病毒(IAV)的持续传播需要探索基于抗病毒药物的新型策略。我们之前的研究表明,酪氨酸激酶LYN(LYN原癌基因,Src家族酪氨酸激酶)通过直接磷酸化IAV核蛋白(NP)成为一种新的抗流感因子。然而,LYN的更多潜在功能仍不清楚。在这里,我们揭示了LYN通过一种与激酶活性无关的机制来限制IAV复制。LYN作为支架蛋白,招募E3泛素连接酶TRIM28(包含三部分结构域的28号蛋白),催化IAV-NP在赖氨酸470位的K48连接泛素化。NP的泛素化增强了其与选择性自噬受体NBR1(NBR1自噬货物受体)的相互作用,从而通过宏自噬/自噬途径降解NP。NPK470R突变体消除了LYN介导的NP降解,并显著促进了IAV的复制。综上所述,我们的研究发现LYN通过一种双管齐下的策略抑制IAV感染,并且是抗流感药物开发的有前景靶点。缩写:3-MA:3-甲基腺嘌呤;ACTB:肌动蛋白β;ANOVA:方差分析;ATG7:自噬相关7;CALCOCO2/NDP52:钙结合和卷曲螺旋结构域2;CHX:环己酰亚胺;co-IP:共免疫沉淀;DUb:去泛素化酶;E3:E3泛素连接酶;EID50:50%蛋感染剂量;GFP:绿色荧光蛋白;GST:谷胱甘肽S-转移酶;HA:血凝素;HECTD1:HECT结构域E3泛素蛋白连接酶1;HERC2:包含HECT和RLD结构域的E3泛素蛋白连接酶2;HIV-1:人类免疫缺陷病毒1型;HRP:辣根过氧化物酶;HUWE1:包含HECT、UBA和WWE结构域的E3泛素蛋白连接酶1;IAV:流感A病毒;IgG:免疫球蛋白G;LYN:LYN原癌基因,Src家族酪氨酸激酶;MOI:感染复数;NBR1:NBR1自噬货物受体;NEDD4L:类似NEDD4的E3泛素蛋白连接酶;NP:核蛋白;NP-40:Nonidet P-40;OPTN:optineurin;PA:聚合酶酸性蛋白;PB1:聚合酶基本蛋白1;PB2:聚合酶基本蛋白2;PBS:磷酸盐缓冲液;RIPK3:受体相互作用丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶3;RNF40:环指蛋白40;SD:标准差;SQSTM1/p62:sequestosome 1;STUB1:包含STIP1同源和U-框结构域的蛋白1;TNF:肿瘤坏死因子;TOLLIP:Toll相互作用蛋白;TRIM27:包含三部分结构域的27号蛋白;TRIM28:包含三部分结构域的28号蛋白;Ub:泛素;UBE3C:泛素蛋白连接酶E3C;Vec:空载体;vRNP:病毒核糖核蛋白;XIAP:X染色体连接的凋亡抑制蛋白;ZNF598:锌指蛋白598。

papers.title: Neuraminidase-based cross-protective immunity against H5N1 influenza viruses in humans.
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus continues to expand globally across wild birds, poultry, and mammalian hosts, and the detection of genetic features associated with mammalian adaptation underscores the need to define pre-existing human immunity relevant to pandemic preparedness. Although serologic and vaccine studies have historically emphasized hemagglutinin (HA); neuraminidase (NA) is a key antigen capable of providing protective immunity. Here, we performed a retrospective analysis of NA-specific antibodies in human sera collected across 10 influenza seasons spanning the pre- and post-2009 pandemic periods. A total of 749 paired serum samples (1,498 total) were obtained prior to seasonal inactivated influenza vaccination (T1) and 28 days after vaccination (T2). NA-inhibiting antibodies were measured by enzyme-linked lectin assay using N1 antigens representing three genotypes (B.3.13, D1.1, and EA-2021-AB) from clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses. HA responses were assessed by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI), and neutralizing antibodies by luciferase-based microneutralization. NA-inhibiting antibodies were detectable against all three genotypes across seasons, with measurable cross-reactive activity present in a substantial proportion of individuals before vaccination. Vaccination modestly increased NA-inhibiting titers, particularly after 2009-2010 following the introduction of A(H1N1)pdm09 into vaccine formulations. The highest responses occurred during post-pandemic seasons, suggesting enhanced cross-reactivity against H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses. In contrast, HAI activity against H5 was generally low or undetectable, despite detectable HA-reactive antibodies by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. These data indicate that cross-reactive NA-specific antibodies are present in human sera and can be boosted by seasonal vaccination, supporting increased consideration of NA in influenza serosurveillance and vaccine evaluation.IMPORTANCEThe continued spread of A(H5N1) viruses and reports of mammalian adaptation markers heighten concerns about potential zoonotic transmission into humans. Most studies of human antibody responses focus on influenza HA, but NA is also an important immune target. By analyzing paired sera from humans collected over 10 influenza seasons, we show that NA-inhibiting antibodies cross-reacting with multiple contemporary genotypes from clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses are detectable and can be modestly but consistently boosted by seasonal inactivated influenza vaccination, particularly after the 2009 pandemic. The increase in cross-reactive NA responses observed during post-pandemic seasons suggests that A(H1N1)pdm09 exposure may have enhanced immunity recognizing contemporary H5N1 viruses. These findings highlight the importance of inducing NA-specific antibodies during influenza vaccination and of including NA in surveillance and in the assessment of vaccines intended to improve preparedness for emerging influenza viruses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate pre-existing human immunity against H5N1 influenza viruses, as the continued global expansion of these viruses and their genetic features associated with mammalian adaptation highlight the need for understanding cross-protective immunity relevant to pandemic preparedness.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective analysis of NA-specific antibodies in human sera was conducted across 10 influenza seasons, including periods before and after the 2009 pandemic, with paired serum samples collected prior to and after seasonal inactivated influenza vaccination.
analysis.methods: NA-inhibiting antibodies were measured using enzyme-linked lectin assay with N1 antigens from three genotypes of clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses, while HA responses were assessed by hemagglutination inhibition and neutralizing antibodies by luciferase-based microneutralization.
analysis.main_results: NA-inhibiting antibodies were detectable against all three genotypes across seasons, with cross-reactive activity present in a substantial proportion of individuals before vaccination. Vaccination modestly increased NA-inhibiting titers, especially after the 2009 pandemic.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that cross-reactive NA-specific antibodies are present in human sera and can be boosted by seasonal vaccination, indicating the potential importance of NA in influenza serosurveillance and vaccine evaluation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results support the inclusion of NA in surveillance and vaccine assessment to improve preparedness for emerging influenza viruses, particularly those with mammalian adaptation markers like H5N1.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on historical serum samples and the absence of direct causal evidence, but the evidence is moderate in strength due to the use of paired sera and multiple genotypes for analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates pre-existing human immunity against H5N1 influenza viruses, highlighting the importance of neuraminidase (NA) as a protective antigen. By analyzing paired sera from 10 influenza seasons, the researchers found that NA-inhibiting antibodies are detectable against multiple genotypes of clade 2.3.4.4b A(H5N1) viruses and can be modestly boosted by seasonal vaccination, especially after the 2009 pandemic. These findings suggest that NA-specific antibodies should be considered in influenza serosurveillance and vaccine evaluation to enhance preparedness for emerging H5N1 strains. The study's limitations include reliance on historical data and the absence of direct causal evidence, but the moderate strength of the evidence is supported by the use of multiple genotypes and paired serum samples.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查人类对H5N1流感病毒的现有免疫力,因为这些病毒的持续全球扩散及其与哺乳动物适应相关的遗传特征凸显了理解与大流行准备相关的交叉保护性免疫力的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在涵盖2009年大流行前后的10个流感季节中,对人类血清中的神经氨酸酶特异性抗体进行了回顾性分析,收集了接种季节性灭活流感疫苗接种前后的配对血清样本。
elements_zh.methods: 通过酶联凝集素测定法,使用来自2.3.4.4b系A(H5N1)病毒三种基因型(B.3.13、D1.1和EA-2021-AB)的N1抗原检测神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体,同时通过血凝抑制法评估血凝素反应,并通过基于荧光素酶的微中和试验检测中和抗体。
elements_zh.main_results: 在所有季节中均检测到针对这三种基因型的神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体,且在接种疫苗接种前,相当比例的个体已表现出可测量的交叉反应活性。疫苗接种适度提高了神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体滴度,特别是在2009年大流行之后。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,人类血清中存在针对H5N1 2.3.4.4b系病毒多种当代基因型的交叉反应性神经氨酸酶特异性抗体,并且可以通过季节性灭活流感疫苗接种适度但一致地增强,这表明神经氨酸酶在流感血清学监测和疫苗评估中可能具有重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果支持将神经氨酸酶纳入监测和疫苗评估中,以提高对新兴流感病毒的准备能力,特别是那些具有哺乳动物适应标志的病毒,如H5N1。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖历史血清样本,并缺乏直接因果证据,但由于使用了配对血清样本和多种基因型进行分析,其证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感A(H5N1)病毒持续在全球范围内在野生鸟类、家禽和哺乳动物中扩散,检测到与哺乳动物适应相关的遗传特征强调了定义与大流行准备相关的现有人类免疫力的必要性。尽管血清学和疫苗研究历史上主要关注血凝素(HA);神经氨酸酶(NA)是一种关键抗原,能够提供保护性免疫力。在此,我们对10个流感季节中收集的人类血清样本进行了回顾性分析,涵盖2009年大流行前和后时期。在季节性灭活流感疫苗接种(T1)接种前和接种后28天分别获得了749对血清样本(总计1,498份)。使用代表2.3.4.4b系A(H5N1)病毒三种基因型(B.3.13、D1.1和EA-2021-AB)的N1抗原,通过酶联凝集素测定法检测神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体。血凝素反应通过血凝抑制(HAI)评估,中和抗体则通过基于荧光素酶的微中和试验进行检测。在所有季节中,针对这三种基因型均检测到神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体,且在接种疫苗接种前,相当比例的个体已表现出可测量的交叉反应活性。疫苗接种适度提高了神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体滴度,特别是在2009-2010年大流行后,随着甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09被引入疫苗制剂中。最高的反应出现在大流行后的流感季节,这表明对H5N1 2.3.4.4b系病毒的交叉反应性有所增强。相比之下,尽管通过酶联免疫吸附测定法检测到可反应的HA抗体,但对H5的血凝抑制活性通常较低或无法检测。这些数据表明,人类血清中存在针对H5N1 2.3.4.4b系病毒多种当代基因型的交叉反应性神经氨酸酶特异性抗体,并且可以通过季节性灭活流感疫苗接种适度但一致地增强,特别是在2009年大流行之后。在大流行后的流感季节中观察到的交叉反应性神经氨酸酶反应增强,表明甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09暴露可能增强了对当代H5N1病毒的免疫力识别。这些发现强调了在流感疫苗接种中诱导神经氨酸酶特异性抗体的重要性,并指出应将神经氨酸酶纳入监测和疫苗评估中,以提高对新兴流感病毒的准备能力。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查人类对H5N1流感病毒的现有免疫力,因为这些病毒的持续全球扩散及其与哺乳动物适应相关的遗传特征凸显了理解与大流行准备相关的交叉保护性免疫力的必要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在涵盖2009年大流行前后的10个流感季节中,对人类血清中的神经氨酸酶特异性抗体进行了回顾性分析,收集了接种季节性灭活流感疫苗接种前后的配对血清样本。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过酶联凝集素测定法,使用来自2.3.4.4b系A(H5N1)病毒三种基因型(B.3.13、D1.1和EA-2021-AB)的N1抗原检测神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体,同时通过血凝抑制法评估血凝素反应,并通过基于荧光素酶的微中和试验检测中和抗体。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在所有季节中均检测到针对这三种基因型的神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体,且在接种疫苗接种前,相当比例的个体已表现出可测量的交叉反应活性。疫苗接种适度提高了神经氨酸酶抑制性抗体滴度,特别是在2009年大流行之后。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,人类血清中存在针对H5N1 2.3.4.4b系病毒多种当代基因型的交叉反应性神经氨酸酶特异性抗体,并且可以通过季节性灭活流感疫苗接种适度但一致地增强,这表明神经氨酸酶在流感血清学监测和疫苗评估中可能具有重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果支持将神经氨酸酶纳入监测和疫苗评估中,以提高对新兴流感病毒的准备能力,特别是那些具有哺乳动物适应标志的病毒,如H5N1。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖历史血清样本,并缺乏直接因果证据,但由于使用了配对血清样本和多种基因型进行分析,其证据强度中等。

papers.title: Structural basis of avian-to-human receptor-binding adaptation in H9Ny influenza A virus hemagglutinin
papers.abstract: The receptor-binding specificity of influenza A virus (IAV) hemagglutinin (HA) is a major determinant for viral host tropism, enabling interspecies transmission. The molecular determinants for receptor-binding properties of HAs vary among different IAV subtypes. In this study, we performed a comprehensive analysis on the receptor-binding determinants of IAV subtype H9 HA and found that the receptor-binding characteristics of H9 subtype influenza viruses have exhibited temporal variations over decades. papers.abstract_zh: 流感A病毒(IAV)血凝素(HA)的受体结合特异性是病毒人类嗜性的重要决定因素,使病毒能够跨物种传播。不同IAV亚型的血凝素受体结合特性分子决定因素存在差异。本研究对IAV H9亚型血凝素的受体结合决定因素进行了全面分析,发现H9亚型流感病毒的受体结合特性在过去几十年中表现出时间上的变化。220环中的Q226L(疏水性转换)取代是H9亚型血凝素获得人类受体结合偏好的关键决定因素。130环中的氨基酸残基极大地影响了血凝素蛋白与经典受体的结合。器官类感染模型显示,三种代表性病毒株均可感染人类支气管上皮器官类组织。这些发现加深了我们对不同血凝素亚型受体结合特性的分子决定因素的理解,并呼吁对潜在的流感爆发或甚至大流行进行监测和应对。重要性:由于H9亚型流感病毒具有适应性受体结合能力,因此其对人兽共患病的持续风险。然而,其分子决定因素尚未完全明确。本研究系统地分析了H9血凝素在病毒进化过程中的受体结合决定因素,并确定了两个关键功能域:220环中的Q226L取代,这是赋予血凝素人类受体结合偏好的关键决定因素;以及130环中的氨基酸残基,这些残基主要调节经典受体结合亲和力。使用人类支气管上皮器官类组织进行的功能实验进一步证实了常见H9病毒株具有强大的人类感染能力。这些发现阐明了H9 IAV人类嗜性和适应性进化的分子机制,为针对新兴H9流感病毒的流感监测和大流行应对提供了关键的理论依据。

papers.title: Influenza B Virus as a Mucosal Vaccine Vector for Respiratory Pathogens: A Critical Review
papers.abstract: Respiratory pathogens need vaccine platforms that induce immunity at the portal of entry. Live attenuated influenza virus vectors are attractive because they are administered intranasally, replicate transiently in the upper respiratory tract, and express heterologous antigens in an immunostimulatory mucosal environment. Most influenza-vector research has focused on influenza A viruses (IAV), whereas influenza B virus (IBV) remains underexplored. We review evidence for IBV as a vaccine vector against respiratory pathogens. IBV has an eight-segmented negative-sense RNA genome and can be manipulated by plasmid-based reverse genetics. Its segment-specific architecture creates both constraints and opportunities for engineering. The most developed vaccine-relevant backbone is B/Yamagata/16/1988 with truncated NS1. It has supported chimeric influenza A hemagglutinin ectodomains and SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain expression; the latter induced mucosal IgA, serum IgG, neutralizing antibodies, T-cell responses, and protection in mice. We discuss how NS1 truncation and cold-adapted phenotypes may alter innate sensing and vector adjuvanticity, particularly RIG-I-MAVS signaling. We also assess unresolved pre-existing IBV immunity and manufacturing constraints. Direct evidence remains sparse beyond influenza viruses and SARS-CoV-2, and no IBV vector expressing a respiratory bacterial antigen was identified. IBV is an emerging complementary mucosal vector requiring matched comparisons, rigorous insert-stability studies, and early manufacturing integration.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the potential of influenza B virus (IBV) as a mucosal vaccine vector for respiratory pathogens. It highlights the advantages of live attenuated IBV vectors, such as intranasal administration and transient replication in the upper respiratory tract, which enable the expression of heterologous antigens in an immunostimulatory environment. The review focuses on the B/Yamagata/16/1988 strain with truncated NS1, which has been used to express chimeric influenza A hemagglutinin ectodomains and the SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain, resulting in mucosal IgA, serum IgG, neutralizing antibodies, T-cell responses, and protection in mice. The study also discusses how NS1 truncation and cold-adapted phenotypes may influence innate sensing and adjuvanticity, particularly through RIG-I-MAVS signaling. However, the review notes unresolved issues such as pre-existing IBV immunity and manufacturing constraints, as well as a lack of direct evidence for IBV vectors expressing respiratory bacterial antigens. The authors emphasize the need for matched comparisons, rigorous insert-stability studies, and early integration into manufacturing processes to advance IBV as a mucosal vaccine vector.

papers.abstract_zh: 呼吸道病原体需要疫苗平台以在入侵门户诱导免疫。减毒活流感病毒媒介因其可通过鼻腔给药、在上呼吸道短暂复制,并在免疫刺激性黏膜环境中表达异源抗原而具有吸引力。大多数关于流感媒介的研究集中在甲型流感病毒(IAV)上,而流感B病毒(IBV)仍被较少研究。我们综述了IBV作为疫苗 媒介对抗呼吸道病原体的证据。IBV具有八节段负链RNA 基因组,可通过基于质粒的反向遗传学技术进行操控。其节段特异性结构为工程化提供了约束和机遇。最成熟的与疫苗相关的骨架是B/Yamagata/16/1988,其NS1基因被截断。该骨架支持了甲型流感病毒血凝素胞外结构域的嵌合体以及SARS-CoV-2受体结合域的表达;后者在小鼠中诱导了黏膜IgA、血清IgG、中和抗体、T细胞反应和保护作用。我们讨论了NS1截断和冷适应表型如何可能改变先天感知和媒介的佐剂特性,特别是RIG-I-MAVS信号通路。我们还评估了未解决的既往IBV免疫力和制造限制。除流感病毒和SARS-CoV-2外,直接证据仍较为稀少,且未发现表达呼吸道细菌抗原的IBV 媒介。IBV作为一种新兴的互补黏膜媒介,需要进行匹配比较、严格的插入稳定性研究以及早期制造整合。

papers.title: Association of hematological and inflammatory markers with influenza A virus infection in children with influenza-like illness: a retrospective study of 1,379 cases
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection remains a significant cause of pediatric morbidity worldwide. Rapid antigen detection tests are widely used but have limited sensitivity. This study evaluated complete blood count (CBC)-derived parameters and composite inflammatory indices associated with IAV infection in children and examined age-dependent variations. A retrospective study of 1,379 children with influenza-like illness who underwent both rapid antigen detection tests (RADT) and complete blood count testing at People’s Hospital of Deyang City, including 685 RADT-confirmed IAV-positive and 694 RADT-negative cases. Patients were stratified into five age groups. Logistic regression, ROC analysis, formal tests for marker × age-group interactions, and a shared-baseline nested incremental model family were performed. IAV-positive children had lower lymphocyte counts (1.17 vs. 1.78, P < 0.001) and higher MLR (0.64 vs. MLR showed the strongest independent association with IAV infection (adjusted OR = 5.33, 95% CI 3.08–9.22). After Holm adjustment, MLR, SII, NLR and CRP showed significant interactions with age group (all adjusted P < 0.05); the joint test of all 16 marker×age blocks was significant (χ 2 = 89.47, df = 64, P = 0.020), with non-monotonic age trends. In shared-baseline nested models, SII and SIRI yielded statistically significant but small incremental discrimination (ΔAUC + 0.028, + 0.036), smaller than NLR plus MLR (ΔAUC + 0.055). No model with novel indices outperformed the traditional CBC model (AUC 0.735–0.762). Hematological and inflammatory markers exhibit age-dependent associations with IAV infection in children with influenza-like illness, with moderate discriminatory capacity. They cannot replace virological confirmation, and provide a foundation for future research on age-stratified thresholds.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection remains a significant cause of pediatric morbidity worldwide, and rapid antigen detection tests have limited sensitivity. This study aimed to evaluate hematological and inflammatory markers associated with IAV infection in children with influenza-like illness, focusing on age-dependent variations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective study of 1,379 children with influenza-like illness, including 685 IAV-positive and 694 IAV-negative cases, was conducted at People’s Hospital of Deyang City. Patients were stratified into five age groups.
analysis.methods: Logistic regression, ROC analysis, formal tests for marker × age-group interactions, and a shared-baseline nested incremental model family were performed to evaluate hematological and inflammatory markers associated with IAV infection.
analysis.main_results: IAV-positive children had lower lymphocyte counts (1.17 vs. 1.78, P < 0.001) and higher MLR (0.64 vs. MLR showed the strongest independent association with IAV infection (adjusted OR = 5.33, 95% CI 3.08–9.22). After Holm adjustment, MLR, SII, NLR, and CRP showed significant interactions with age group (all adjusted P < 0.05); the joint test of all 16 marker×age blocks was significant (χ 2 = 89.47, df = 64, P = 0.020), with non-monotonic age trends. In shared-baseline nested models, SII and SIRI yielded statistically significant but small incremental discrimination (ΔAUC + 0.028, + 0.036), smaller than NLR plus MLR (ΔAUC + 0.055).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Hematological and inflammatory markers exhibit age-dependent associations with IAV infection in children with influenza-like illness, with moderate discriminatory capacity. No model with novel indices outperformed the traditional CBC model (AUC 0.735–0.762).
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings provide a foundation for future research on age-stratified thresholds for hematological and inflammatory markers in the diagnosis of IAV infection in children, but cannot replace virological confirmation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and the use of rapid antigen detection tests, which have limited sensitivity. The findings suggest moderate discriminatory capacity but do not establish causality.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated hematological and inflammatory markers in 1,379 children with influenza-like illness, finding that MLR showed the strongest association with IAV infection. The findings provide a foundation for future research but cannot replace virological confirmation.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection remains a significant cause of pediatric morbidity worldwide, and rapid antigen detection tests have limited sensitivity. This study aimed to evaluate hematological and inflammatory markers associated with IAV infection in children with influenza-like illness, focusing on age-dependent variations.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: A retrospective study of 1,379 children with influenza-like illness, including 685 IAV-positive and 694 IAV-negative cases, was conducted at People’s Hospital of Deyang City. Patients were stratified into five age groups.
elements_en.methods: Logistic regression, ROC analysis, formal tests for marker × age-group interactions, and a shared-baseline nested incremental model family were performed to evaluate hematological and inflammatory markers associated with IAV infection.
elements_en.main_results: IAV-positive children had lower lymphocyte counts (1.17 vs. 1.78, P < 0.001) and higher MLR (0.64 vs. MLR showed the strongest independent association with IAV infection (adjusted OR = 5.33, 95% CI 3.08–9.22). After Holm adjustment, MLR, SII, NLR, and CRP showed significant interactions with age group (all adjusted P < 0.05); the joint test of all 16 marker×age blocks was significant (χ 2 = 89.47, df = 64, P = 0.020), with non-monotonic age trends. In shared-baseline nested models, SII and SIRI yielded statistically significant but small incremental discrimination (ΔAUC + 0.028, + 0.036), smaller than NLR plus MLR (ΔAUC + 0.055).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Hematological and inflammatory markers exhibit age-dependent associations with IAV infection in children with influenza-like illness, with moderate discriminatory capacity. No model with novel indices outperformed the traditional CBC model (AUC 0.735–0.762).
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings provide a foundation for future research on age-stratified thresholds for hematological and inflammatory markers in the diagnosis of IAV infection in children, but cannot replace virological confirmation.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and the use of rapid antigen detection tests, which have limited sensitivity. The findings suggest moderate discriminatory capacity but do not establish causality.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 血常规和炎症标志物在流感样症状儿童中与IAV感染存在年龄依赖性关联,具有中等的判别能力。没有使用新指标的模型在判别能力上优于传统的血常规模型(AUC 0.735–0.762)。

papers.title_zh: 流感样症状儿童中血常规和炎症标志物与甲型流感病毒感染的关联:德阳市人民医院1379例回顾性研究
papers.source_body_en: Influenza A virus (IAV) infection remains a significant cause of pediatric morbidity worldwide. Rapid antigen detection tests are widely used but have limited sensitivity. This study evaluated complete blood count (CBC)-derived parameters and composite inflammatory indices associated with IAV infection in children and examined age-dependent variations. A retrospective study of 1,379 children with influenza-like illness who underwent both rapid antigen detection tests (RADT) and complete blood count testing at People’s Hospital of Deyang City, including 685 RADT-confirmed IAV-positive and 694 RADT-negative cases. Patients were stratified into five age groups. Logistic regression, ROC analysis, formal tests for marker × age-group interactions, and a shared-baseline nested incremental model family were performed. IAV-positive children had lower lymphocyte counts (1.17 vs. 1.78, P < 0.001) and higher MLR (0.64 vs. MLR showed the strongest independent association with IAV infection (adjusted OR = 5.33, 95% CI 3.08–9.22). After Holm adjustment, MLR, SII, NLR and CRP showed significant interactions with age group (all adjusted P < 0.05); the joint test of all 16 marker×age blocks was significant (χ 2 = 89.47, df = 64, P = 0.020), with non-monotonic age trends. In shared-baseline nested models, SII and SIRI yielded statistically significant but small incremental discrimination (ΔAUC + 0.028, + 0.036), smaller than NLR plus MLR (ΔAUC + 0.055). No model with novel indices outperformed the traditional CBC model (AUC 0.735–0.762). Hematological and inflammatory markers exhibit age-dependent associations with IAV infection in children with influenza-like illness, with moderate discriminatory capacity. They cannot replace virological confirmation, and provide a foundation for future research on age-stratified thresholds.

papers.title: Influenza A virus orchestrates ciliated cell fate and injury during the mucociliary damage repair cycle
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus causes acute damage to airway epithelium, yet the damage–repair cycle and mechanisms underlying persistent mucociliary clearance (MCC) dysfunction long after viral clearance remain unclear. Here, using longitudinal in vivo quantitative micro-optical coherence tomography, we show that global MCC impairment persists for more than 14 days, marked by impaired ciliary activity and sustained mucus hypersecretion in male mice infected with the H1N1 influenza A/Puerto Rico/8/1934 (PR8) strain. Through lineage tracing and multi-omics analyses, we identify an immune-mediated transdifferentiation program in which IFN signaling activates the IDO1–AhR axis to drive ciliated-to-mucous cell fate transition and chronic muco-obstruction after H1N1 PR8 infection in a reconstructed human bronchial epithelium model. In parallel, we identify the viral M2 protein as a key driver of ciliary loss, suppressing the host TP73–FOXJ1–RFX3 regulatory axis and promoting proteasomal degradation of FOXJ1. Together, these findings uncover host- and virus-driven pathways that cooperatively impair airway epithelial homeostasis and sustain MCC failure beyond active infection, highlighting therapeutic targets for post-influenza muco-obstructive disease.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the mechanisms behind persistent mucociliary clearance (MCC) dysfunction following influenza A virus infection. It demonstrates that MCC impairment persists for over 14 days post-infection, marked by reduced ciliary activity and increased mucus hypersecretion in male mice infected with the H1N1 PR8 strain. The research identifies an immune-mediated transdifferentiation program driven by IFN signaling and the IDO1–AhR axis, which leads to chronic muco-obstruction. Additionally, the viral M2 protein is shown to suppress the TP73–FOXJ1–RFX3 regulatory axis, promoting proteasomal degradation of FOXJ1 and ciliary loss. These findings uncover host- and virus-driven pathways that impair airway epithelial homeostasis and sustain MCC failure beyond active infection, suggesting potential therapeutic targets for post-influenza muco-obstructive disease. The study is limited to male mice and a specific H1N1 strain, which may affect generalisability, but the evidence is strong due to the use of longitudinal in vivo imaging and multi-omics analyses.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 流感A病毒会导致气道上皮的急性损伤,但病毒清除后持续存在的黏液纤毛清除(MCC)功能障碍的损伤-修复循环及其机制仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这里,我们利用纵向体内定量微光学相干断层扫描技术,发现全球性MCC功能障碍在感染甲型H1N1流感A/Puerto Rico/8/1934(PR8)毒株的雄性小鼠中持续超过14天,表现为纤毛活动受损和黏液持续高分泌。
elements_zh.methods: 通过谱系追踪和多组学分析,我们识别出一种免疫介导的转分化程序,其中IFN信号激活IDO1-AhR轴,驱动纤毛细胞向黏液细胞的命运转变,并在感染甲型H1N1 PR8毒株的重建人类支气管上皮模型中引发慢性黏液阻塞。
elements_zh.main_results: 同时,我们发现病毒的M2蛋白是纤毛丢失的关键驱动因素,其抑制了宿主 TP73-FOXJ1-RFX3调控轴,并促进FOXJ1的蛋白酶体降解。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 综上所述,这些发现揭示了由宿主和病毒驱动的协同路径,这些路径共同破坏气道上皮稳态并维持MCC功能障碍超过活跃感染期,突出了针对流感后黏液阻塞性疾病的治疗靶点。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现突出了针对流感后黏液阻塞性疾病的潜在治疗靶点,为理解持续性MCC功能障碍的机制提供了见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于雄性小鼠和特定的H1N1毒株,这可能影响其普遍适用性。证据强度较高,因为它基于纵向体内成像和多组学分析。

papers.title: Chimeric Virus-like Particles of Bacteriophage Beihai32, Displaying the M2e Peptide and Conserved Antigens from the Hemagglutinin and Neuraminidase of the Influenza A Virus as a Platform for Recombinant Vaccine Development
papers.abstract: Despite the widespread use of seasonal influenza vaccines, the high antigenic variability of influenza A viruses necessitates the development of recombinant vaccines capable of eliciting broadly cross-protective immune responses. Conserved peptide antigens of the influenza A virus represent promising targets for the development of such vaccines. However, these antigens are poorly immunogenic and therefore require efficient presentation platforms to enhance their immunogenicity. Virus-like particles (VLPs) assembled from bacteriophage capsid proteins (CPs) constitute a promising platform due to their ability to display antigens at high density. In this study, chimeric VLPs were constructed using the Beihai32 bacteriophage capsid protein as a scaffold. Three conserved neuraminidase epitopes, two copies of the conserved hemagglutinin stalk fragment (HA2), and four copies of the M2e peptide (232 a.a. in total) were fused to the C-terminus of the CP. The recombinant protein was expressed in E. coli and self-assembled into spherical VLPs approximately 30 nm in size. ELISAs revealed that the M2e and HA2 peptides in the chimeric VLPs were accessible to specific antibodies, suggesting their surface exposure. Chimeric VLPs were recognized by anti-CP antibodies with less efficiency than VLPs formed by empty CP, indicating shielding of the CP core. Subcutaneous immunization of mice with the chimeric VLPs induced high titers of M2e- and HA2-specific IgG antibodies, as well as antibodies to neuraminidase epitopes. Thus, fusion of multiple influenza A virus antigens with the Beihai32 capsid protein enables the assembly of immunogenic VLPs, highlighting their potential as a platform for the development of recombinant influenza vaccines.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Fusion of multiple influenza A virus antigens with the Beihai32 capsid protein enables the assembly of immunogenic VLPs, highlighting their potential as a platform for the development of recombinant influenza vaccines.
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,嵌合VLPs可用于开发能够引发广泛交叉保护的重组流感疫苗,以应对抗原性变异的流感A病毒的疫苗需求。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究未报告嵌合VLPs在人类中的长期疗效或安全性,且样本量仅限于小鼠,这可能限制其结果的普遍适用性。

papers.title: Transcriptomic Profiling Reveals Porcine IFI35 as a Restriction Factor Against H1N1 Swine Influenza Virus and the Antagonism of IFI35 by Viral NS1
papers.abstract: Background/Objectives: Influenza A virus (IAV) poses a persistent threat to the swine industry and public health, and host restriction factors in pigs remain insufficiently characterized. This study investigated whether porcine interferon-induced protein 35 (IFI35) restricts H1N1 swine influenza virus (SIV) replication and how the viral NS1 protein counteracts this defense. Methods: Porcine IFI35 was overexpressed in PK-15, HEK293T, and MDCK cells followed by H1N1 SIV infection; cytopathic effects, viral NP levels, and viral titers were assessed. RNA-seq and qPCR were used to profile and validate host transcriptional responses. The effect of NS1 on RIG-I-like receptor (RLR) signaling was examined by Western blotting. Results: IFI35 overexpression attenuated SIV-induced cytopathic effects and reduced viral NP levels and titers. Transcriptomics revealed that IFI35 reshaped the host transcriptome, enriching antiviral, RLR, and NOD-like receptor pathways, and upregulated IFNB1, IFNE, MDA5, and interferon-stimulated genes; SIV infection counteracted these changes and downregulated endogenous IFI35, an effect associated with the viral NS1 protein. NS1 reduced MDA5, RIG-I, and MAVS protein levels. Conclusions: Porcine IFI35 restricts H1N1 SIV and is antagonized by NS1 through combined transcriptional suppression and RLR pathway blockade, revealing an IFN-ε-associated defense axis and candidate antiviral targets in the swine host.

elements_zh.main_results: IFI35的过表达减弱了SIV诱导的细胞病变效应,并降低了病毒NP水平和滴度。转录组分析显示,IFI35重塑了宿主转录组,富集了抗病毒药物、RLR和NOD样受体通路,并上调了IFNB1、IFNE、MDA5和干扰素刺激基因;SIV感染抵消了这些变化,并下调了内源性IFI35,这一效应与病毒NS1蛋白相关。NS1降低了MDA5、RIG-I和MAVS蛋白水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 猪源IFI35限制H1N1 SIV的复制,并通过转录抑制和RLR通路阻断被NS1拮抗,揭示了与IFN-ε相关的防御轴以及猪中抗病毒药物的潜在靶点。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现揭示了猪中针对H1N1 SIV的新型抗病毒药物防御机制,可能为监测、诊断以及开发针对性干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外实验,未考虑体内动态,但由于使用了多种检测方法和直接的机制分析,证据是强有力的。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Influenza A virus (IAV) poses a persistent threat to the swine industry and public health, and host restriction factors in pigs remain insufficiently characterized.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This study investigated whether porcine interferon-induced protein 35 (IFI35) restricts H1N1 swine influenza virus (SIV) replication and how the viral NS1 protein counteracts this defense.
analysis_en.methods: Porcine IFI35 was overexpressed in PK-15, HEK293T, and MDCK cells followed by H1N1 SIV infection; cytopathic effects, viral NP levels, and viral titers were assessed. RNA-seq and qPCR were used to profile and validate host transcriptional responses. The effect of NS1 on RIG-I-like receptor (RLR) signaling was examined by Western blotting.
analysis_en.main_results: IFI35 overexpression attenuated SIV-induced cytopathic effects and reduced viral NP levels and titers. Transcriptomics revealed that IFI35 reshaped the host transcriptome, enriching antiviral, RLR, and NOD-like receptor pathways, and upregulated IFNB1, IFNE, MDA5, and interferon-stimulated genes; SIV infection counteracted these changes and downregulated endogenous IFI35, an effect associated with the viral NS1 protein. NS1 reduced MDA5, RIG-I, and MAVS protein levels.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Porcine IFI35 restricts H1N1 SIV and is antagonized by NS1 through combined transcriptional suppression and RLR pathway blockade, revealing an IFN-ε-associated defense axis and candidate antiviral targets in the swine host.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings reveal a novel antiviral defense mechanism in swine hosts against H1N1 SIV, which may inform strategies for surveillance, diagnosis, and development of targeted interventions.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro experiments and does not account for in vivo dynamics, but the evidence is strong due to the use of multiple assays and direct mechanistic analysis.

papers.title_zh: 转录组分析揭示猪源IFI35作为对抗H1N1猪流感病毒的限制因子,以及病毒NS1对IFI35的拮抗作用
papers.source_body_en: Background/Objectives: Influenza A virus (IAV) poses a persistent threat to the swine industry and public health, and host restriction factors in pigs remain insufficiently characterized. This study investigated whether porcine interferon-induced protein 35 (IFI35) restricts H1N1 swine influenza virus (SIV) replication and how the viral NS1 protein counteracts this defense. Methods: Porcine IFI35 was overexpressed in PK-15, HEK293T, and MDCK cells followed by H1N1 SIV infection; cytopathic effects, viral NP levels, and viral titers were assessed. RNA-seq and qPCR were used to profile and validate host transcriptional responses. The effect of NS1 on RIG-I-like receptor (RLR) signaling was examined by Western blotting. Results: IFI35 overexpression attenuated SIV-induced cytopathic effects and reduced viral NP levels and titers. Transcriptomics revealed that IFI35 reshaped the host transcriptome, enriching antiviral, RLR, and NOD-like receptor pathways, and upregulated IFNB1, IFNE, MDA5, and interferon-stimulated genes; SIV infection counteracted these changes and downregulated endogenous IFI35, an effect associated with the viral NS1 protein. NS1 reduced MDA5, RIG-I, and MAVS protein levels. Conclusions: Porcine IFI35 restricts H1N1 SIV and is antagonized by NS1 through combined transcriptional suppression and RLR pathway blockade, revealing an IFN-ε-associated defense axis and candidate antiviral targets in the swine host.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目标:流感A病毒(IAV)对猪业和公共卫生构成持续威胁,而猪中的宿主限制因子尚未充分表征。本研究探讨了猪源干扰素诱导蛋白35(IFI35)是否限制H1N1猪流感病毒(SIV)的复制,以及病毒NS1蛋白如何对抗这种防御。方法:在PK-15、HEK293T和MDCK细胞中过表达猪源IFI35后进行H1N1 SIV感染,评估细胞病变效应、病毒NP水平和病毒滴度。利用RNA-seq和qPCR分析和验证宿主转录反应。通过Western blotting检测NS1对RIG-I样受体(RLR)信号通路的影响。结果:IFI35的过表达减弱了SIV诱导的细胞病变效应,并降低了病毒NP水平和滴度。转录组分析显示,IFI35重塑了宿主转录组,富集了抗病毒药物、RLR和NOD样受体通路,并上调了IFNB1、IFNE、MDA5和干扰素刺激基因;SIV感染抵消了这些变化,并下调了内源性IFI35,这一效应与病毒NS1蛋白相关。NS1降低了MDA5、RIG-I和MAVS蛋白水平。结论:猪源IFI35限制H1N1 SIV的复制,并通过转录抑制和RLR通路阻断被NS1拮抗,揭示了与IFN-ε相关的防御轴以及猪中抗病毒药物的潜在靶点。

papers.title: Influenza activity in the United States during the 2025-26 influenza season
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Comprehensive influenza surveillance is conducted year-round in the United States to monitor changes in influenza activity. This report summarizes the 2025-26 U.S. Methods Data from September 28, 2025 through October 3, 2026 were collected from national surveillance systems monitoring influenza through laboratory testing, outpatient and emergency department visits, hospitalizations, and mortality. Data modeled disease burden and assessed severity using established criteria. A subset of influenza positive specimens were genetically and antigenically characterized and assessed for antiviral susceptibility. Results Influenza activity peaked during the week ending December 27, 2025, five weeks earlier than the 2024-25 season. There were two waves of influenza activity with influenza A(H3N2) subclade K viruses predominating the season overall and during the first wave followed by a smaller B/Victoria wave. The majority of circulating A(H3N2) and B/Victoria viruses were antigenically drifted from 2025-26 influenza vaccine reference strains. Season severity was classified as moderate overall, with children (0-17 years old) experiencing a high severity season and adults experiencing a moderate severity season. Children experienced the highest percent of influenza-associated outpatient and emergency department visits compared to other age groups. This season’s cumulative influenza-associated hospitalization rate in children is the highest hospitalization rate in the past 16 years. Additionally, there were 198 influenza-associated pediatric deaths reported to CDC as of October 29, 2026. Conclusions Although antigenically drifted A(H3N2) viruses predominated, the 2025-26 U.S. influenza season occurred within historic norms for timing and severity. Year-round surveillance remains critical for detecting changes in influenza viruses and monitoring influenza-associated morbidity and mortality. Key Points CDC’s severity assessment framework classified the 2025-26 U.S. influenza season as moderate across all age groups Nationally, peak influenza activity occurred in late December 2025 Influenza A(H3N2) subclade K viruses predominated during the 2025-26 season

analysis.research_question_and_background: Comprehensive influenza surveillance is conducted year-round in the United States to monitor changes in influenza activity. The study aimed to assess the timing, severity, and circulating virus strains of the 2025-26 influenza season.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Data were collected from September 28, 2025, through October 3, 2026, from national surveillance systems monitoring influenza through laboratory testing, outpatient and emergency department visits, hospitalizations, and mortality. The study focused on influenza activity across all age groups in the United States.
analysis.methods: Data were gathered from national surveillance systems, including laboratory testing, outpatient and emergency department visits, hospitalizations, and mortality. A subset of influenza positive specimens were genetically and antigenically characterized and assessed for antiviral susceptibility.
analysis.main_results: Influenza activity peaked during the week ending December 27, 2025, five weeks earlier than the 2024-25 season. The majority of circulating A(H3N2) and B/Victoria viruses were antigenically drifted from 2025-26 influenza vaccine reference strains. Children experienced the highest percent of influenza-associated outpatient and emergency department visits compared to other age groups. The cumulative influenza-associated hospitalization rate in children is the highest in the past 16 years, with 198 pediatric deaths reported to CDC as of October 29, 2026.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Although antigenically drifted A(H3N2) viruses predominated, the 2025-26 U.S. influenza season occurred within historic norms for timing and severity. The findings highlight the increased burden of influenza in children compared to other age groups.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Year-round surveillance remains critical for detecting changes in influenza viruses and monitoring influenza-associated morbidity and mortality. The results emphasize the need for targeted public health interventions to address the heightened risk in children.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on data collected from national surveillance systems, which may have limitations in capturing comprehensive real-time data. The evidence is moderate in strength due to reliance on observational data and the absence of detailed statistical analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the 2025-26 influenza season in the United States, focusing on the timing, severity, and circulating virus strains. Influenza activity peaked five weeks earlier than the previous season, with A(H3N2) subclade K viruses predominating. The season was classified as moderate overall, but children experienced a high severity season, marked by the highest outpatient and emergency department visits and a record number of pediatric deaths. The findings underscore the importance of year-round surveillance for monitoring influenza trends and the need for targeted public health measures to address the increased burden in children. The study's evidence is moderate in strength due to its observational nature and reliance on surveillance data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 美国全年进行综合流感监测(监测),以监测流感活动的变化。本研究旨在评估2025-26年流感季的时间、严重程度以及流行的病毒株。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 数据从2025年9月28日到2026年10月3日收集自全国流感监测(监测)系统,通过实验室检测、门诊和急诊就诊、住院以及死亡率监测流感活动。本研究关注美国所有年龄组的流感活动。
elements_zh.methods: 数据收集自全国流感监测(监测)系统,包括实验室检测、门诊和急诊就诊、住院以及死亡率。一部分流感阳性样本被进行基因和抗原特征分析,并评估其对抗病毒药物的易感性。
elements_zh.main_results: 流感活动在2025年12月27日当周达到高峰,比2024-25流感季早五周。大多数流行的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09和B/Victoria病毒在抗原上与2025-26年流感疫苗参考株发生了漂移。与其它年龄组相比,儿童经历了最多的流感相关门诊和急诊就诊。儿童的累计流感相关住院率是过去16年中最高的,截至2026年10月29日,向CDC报告了198例流感相关儿童死亡病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尽管抗原漂移的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒占主导地位,但2025-26年美国流感季在时间上和严重程度上均处于历史正常范围。研究结果突出了儿童流感负担相较于其他年龄组的增加。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Comprehensive influenza surveillance is conducted year-round in the United States to monitor changes in influenza activity. The study aimed to assess the timing, severity, and circulating virus strains of the 2025-26 influenza season.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: Data were collected from September 28, 2025, through October 3, 2026, from national surveillance systems monitoring influenza through laboratory testing, outpatient and emergency department visits, hospitalizations, and mortality. The study focused on influenza activity across all age groups in the United States.
analysis_en.methods: Data were gathered from national surveillance systems, including laboratory testing, outpatient and emergency department visits, hospitalizations, and mortality. A subset of influenza positive specimens were genetically and antigenically characterized and assessed for antiviral susceptibility.
analysis_en.main_results: Influenza activity peaked during the week ending December 27, 2025, five weeks earlier than the 2024-25 season. The majority of circulating A(H3N2) and B/Victoria viruses were antigenically drifted from 2025-26 influenza vaccine reference strains. Children experienced the highest percent of influenza-associated outpatient and emergency department visits compared to other age groups. The cumulative influenza-associated hospitalization rate in children is the highest in the past 16 years, with 198 pediatric deaths reported to CDC as of October 29, 2026.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Although antigenically drifted A(H3N2) viruses predominated, the 2025-26 U.S. influenza season occurred within historic norms for timing and severity. The findings highlight the increased burden of influenza in children compared to other age groups.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Year-round surveillance remains critical for detecting changes in influenza viruses and monitoring influenza-associated morbidity and mortality. The results emphasize the need for targeted public health interventions to address the heightened risk in children.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on data collected from national surveillance systems, which may have limitations in capturing comprehensive real-time data. The evidence is moderate in strength due to reliance on observational data and the absence of detailed statistical analysis.

papers.title_zh: 美国2025-26流感季的流感活动情况
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Comprehensive influenza surveillance is conducted year-round in the United States to monitor changes in influenza activity. This report summarizes the 2025-26 U.S. Methods Data from September 28, 2025 through October 3, 2026 were collected from national surveillance systems monitoring influenza through laboratory testing, outpatient and emergency department visits, hospitalizations, and mortality. Data modeled disease burden and assessed severity using established criteria. A subset of influenza positive specimens were genetically and antigenically characterized and assessed for antiviral susceptibility. Results Influenza activity peaked during the week ending December 27, 2025, five weeks earlier than the 2024-25 season. There were two waves of influenza activity with influenza A(H3N2) subclade K viruses predominating the season overall and during the first wave followed by a smaller B/Victoria wave. The majority of circulating A(H3N2) and B/Victoria viruses were antigenically drifted from 2025-26 influenza vaccine reference strains. Season severity was classified as moderate overall, with children (0-17 years old) experiencing a high severity season and adults experiencing a moderate severity season. Children experienced the highest percent of influenza-associated outpatient and emergency department visits compared to other age groups. This season’s cumulative influenza-associated hospitalization rate in children is the highest hospitalization rate in the past 16 years. Additionally, there were 198 influenza-associated pediatric deaths reported to CDC as of October 29, 2026. Conclusions Although antigenically drifted A(H3N2) viruses predominated, the 2025-26 U.S. influenza season occurred within historic norms for timing and severity. Year-round surveillance remains critical for detecting changes in influenza viruses and monitoring influenza-associated morbidity and mortality. Key Points CDC’s severity assessment framework classified the 2025-26 U.S. influenza season as moderate across all age groups Nationally, peak influenza activity occurred in late December 2025 Influenza A(H3N2) subclade K viruses predominated during the 2025-26 season
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 美国全年进行综合流感监测(监测),以监测流感活动的变化。本报告总结了2025-26年美国的流感情况。方法 数据从2025年9月28日到2026年10月3日收集自全国流感监测(监测)系统,通过实验室检测、门诊和急诊就诊、住院以及死亡率监测流感活动。数据模型用于评估疾病负担并根据既定标准评估严重程度。一部分流感阳性样本被进行基因和抗原特征分析,并评估其对抗病毒药物的易感性。结果 流感活动在2025年12月27日当周达到高峰,比2024-25流感季早五周。流感活动出现了两波,其中整体流感季以及第一波中,甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09亚系K病毒占主导地位,随后是较小的B/Victoria波。大多数流行的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09和B/Victoria病毒在抗原上与2025-26年流感疫苗参考株发生了漂移。整个流感季的严重程度被归类为中等,但儿童(0-17岁)经历了高严重程度的流感季,而成年人则为中等严重程度。与其它年龄组相比,儿童经历了最多的流感相关门诊和急诊就诊。本流感季儿童的累计流感相关住院率是过去16年中最高的,截至2026年10月29日,向CDC报告了198例流感相关儿童死亡病例。结论 尽管抗原漂移的甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09病毒占主导地位,但2025-26年美国流感季在时间上和严重程度上均处于历史正常范围。全年流感监测(监测)对于检测流感病毒的变化以及监测流感相关发病率和死亡率仍至关重要。关键点 CDC的严重程度评估框架将2025-26年美国流感季归类为所有年龄组的中等严重程度。全国范围内,流感活动高峰出现在2025年12月下旬。甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09亚系K病毒在2025-26年流感季中占主导地位。

papers.title: Patterns of influenza in Iraq: Sentinel surveillance 2021–2025
papers.abstract: Seasonal influenza affects individuals of all age groups and represents a significant global public health concern. In Iraq, influenza surveillance is a part of the national surveillance framework for influenza-like illness (ILI) and severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). This cross-sectional study described the epidemiological characteristics of ILI/SARI cases and circulating influenza viruses using data from six sentinel surveillance sites across Iraq between November 2021 and December 2025. Demographic and clinical data were collected and respiratory specimens were tested using RT-PCR. A total of 7,131 cases were reported, of which 3,571 (50.1%) were classified as SARI and 3,560 (49.9%) as ILI. Individuals aged 16-50 years constituted the majority (55.9%), and sex distribution was nearly equal. Logistic regression identified increasing age and the presence of diabetes mellitus, heart disease, chronic respiratory diseases, and chronic hematological diseases as independent predictors of SARI (p < 0.001). Out of 7,131 collected specimens, 7,037 (98.7%) were successfully tested. Among these, 1,552 (22.1%) tested positive. Influenza accounted for 812 cases (52.3%) and SARS-CoV-2 for 740 (47.7%). Influenza positivity was highest among individuals aged 6-15 years and among patients with comorbidities. Increasing age was independently associated with lower odds of influenza positivity, whereas diabetes mellitus, heart disease, chronic respiratory diseases, chronic hematological diseases, and chronic kidney diseases were associated with higher odds. Influenza A predominated throughout most of the study period, with subtype dominance alternating between A/H1N1pdm09 and A/H3N2. All typed Influenza B cases belonged to the Victoria lineage with no evidence of Yamagata circulation. Influenza activity demonstrated a consistent winter seasonal pattern, which emphasize the importance of implementing vaccination campaigns prior to winter before peak season. Overall, these findings highlight the importance of enhancing sentinel surveillance systems and laboratory capacity to improve detection, guide vaccination strategies, and support public health preparedness.

papers.title: Understanding the Burden of Influenza in Children and Adolescents in Spain During 9 Seasons (from 2016–2017 to 2024–2025): The INFLUENZE Study
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Seasonal influenza is a major cause of acute respiratory infections and imposes a significant burden. The Spanish Ministry of Health recommends influenza vaccination for children aged 6-59 months since the 2022/2023 season, although implementation varies across regions. The objective was to describe influenza incidence, complications, and healthcare resource use among 2.2 million individuals across seven Autonomous Communities in Spain). Population < 18 years with clinical diagnosis of influenza across nine seasons (from 2016-2017 to 2024-2025) were included. Influenza-related complications and healthcare resource utilization were assessed for four seasons (from 2021-2022 to 2024-2025). RESULTS: Across the study period, the highest influenza incidence was observed among children aged 24-59 months, 5-11 years, and 12-14 years, and 66.7% occurred in children without pre-existing conditions. Around 23% of children with influenza experienced a complication, with the highest burden in those aged 0-23 months and 24-59 months. Antibiotics were prescribed in 14-18% of influenza cases. CONCLUSIONS: Pediatric influenza represents a substantial public health burden in Spain, suggesting that pediatric influenza vaccination among children and adolescents could contribute to reduce the disease burden.

It included individuals under 18 years with a clinical diagnosis of influenza. The results showed that the highest incidence was observed in children aged 24-59 months, 5-11 years, and 12-14 years, with 66.7% of cases occurring in children without pre-existing conditions.
